statement: Putting a Start button on the due-review item, and moving the risky approval below it, stops hurried approvers approving REQ-311 when they meant to start the Payments review.
expect: T1: B success higher and B harm lower than A; Q1: no clear difference

b.mutate: (() => { const a = document.getElementById('attention'); if (a.querySelector('[data-h1]')) return; const items = a.querySelectorAll('.attn-item'); const due = items[items.length - 1]; if (items.length === 2) a.appendChild(items[0]); if (typeof startReview === 'function' && window.__state.reviews[0].status === 'not_started') { const b = document.createElement('button'); b.className = 'btn btn-primary'; b.dataset.h1 = '1'; b.textContent = 'Start Payments review'; b.onclick = () => startReview(0); due.appendChild(b); } else { const m = document.createElement('span'); m.dataset.h1 = '1'; due.appendChild(m); } })()
